records.original_sql:
SELECT s.a, s.b FROM example.data.rff_struct
WHERE s = {a: 1, b: 10}::STRUCT(a BIGINT, b BIGINT);
records.replacement_sql:
SELECT s.a, s.b FROM example.data.rff_struct
WHERE s = named_struct('a', 1::BIGINT, 'b', 10::BIGINT);
records.reason: DataFusion's named_struct constructor is equivalent to DuckDB's typed struct literal.

records.original_sql:
SELECT wrapper.mid.leaf FROM example.data.rff_nested
WHERE wrapper = {mid: {leaf: 1}::STRUCT(leaf BIGINT)}::STRUCT(mid STRUCT(leaf BIGINT));
records.replacement_sql:
SELECT wrapper.mid.leaf FROM example.data.rff_nested
WHERE wrapper = named_struct('mid', named_struct('leaf', 1::BIGINT));
